scientific.integrity: The proof independently reconstructs the finite vertex reduction and lower-limit construction from the materially inspected source theorem. The symbolic checker only verifies the regular-pentagon corollary and is not used as proof of the general statement.
limitations: Euclidean polygonal containers only; no hyperbolic finite-vertex analogue is claimed.
The result determines a supremum and does not assert attainment for odd m >= 5.
The explicit stabilization threshold can include ties and is not presented as a minimal odd integer after simplification.

title: Vertex-spectrum formula for odd simple-polygon perimeter suprema
